newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish MP transfers to government party.
newsitem.headline: Turkish MP transfers to government party.

text.p: A Turkish rightist MP on Thursday quit Tansu Ciller's opposition party and joined a party in the ruling coalition, boosting recently appointed Prime Minister Mesut Yilmaz's chances of winning a vote of confidence.
"I wish to carry out my duties as a deputy within the DTP, which supports the government," said MP Cemal Alisan.
The Democratic Turkey Party (DTP) is a small rightist ally of the Yilmaz-led coalition which faces a confidence vote on July 12.
Yilmaz was appointed prime minister last week following the collapse of the coalition between Ciller's party and Islamists.
On paper his government has around a dozen MPs more than the simple majority needed to win the vote in Turkey's 550-seat assembly.
